desc:
Boys vs Girls 👑

Welcome to Boys vs Girls 👑! 6 boys and 6 girls enter, but only the ultimate duo will survive the votes! Do you have enough Aura to find your match and stay standing? 💖✨

✨ How to play:
🗳️ Vote for your favorite contestant of the opposite gender each round to give them likes!
👥 Eliminate competitors round by round until only the last standing couple remains!
💰 Earn Cash with every victory to unlock exclusive dances and premium spots on the map.
⚡ Maximize your Aura and flex your top status to everyone in the server!
💬 Keep all votes and feedback fun and respectful. Show off your style and aura!
